name: Rinkan Gakkou ~Chirasareta Junketsu~
original_name: 輪姦学校 ～散らされた純潔～
source:
Makihara Miki, a member of Karate club, attracted the attention of the student gang, by her courageous act of saving a girl from getting humiliated by bad guys...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE030609.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
空手道社成員牧原美紀勇敢地救下一名險遭壞人羞辱的女孩，因此引起了學生幫派的注意……
